senses.gloss: f. (זָכָה) possession, taking possession, claim. Y. Peah V, beg. 19ᵇ, v. הֶפְקֵר.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 2:2:13">Y. Pes. II, 29ᵃ</cite> top <he>מאן דאמר ז׳</he> according to the opinion that renounced property does not go out of the owner’s possession until somebody took possession of it.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 12b:11">B. Kam. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>אית להו לכהנים ז׳ בגויה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בגוייהו</he>) the priests have a claim on it.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 12b:11">Ib.</cite> <he>ולית להו זכיה</he> Ms. M. (omitted in ed.).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 12a:11">B. Mets. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>אית ליה ז׳ לנפשיה</he> has a right to take possession in his own behalf; a. e.
